description: Claim quality and similarity calibration — AI tools cluster

round1_summary.insight_pattern: Insights are comparative/evaluative claims about PATTERNS, not product-specific facts. 'X is better than Y because...' or 'The key difference is...' or 'Agents add most value when...'
round1_summary.noise_pattern: Noise is product-specific feature lists, generic platitudes, definitions, and trivially obvious claims

round2_summary.system_false_positive_rate: 70% — 7 of 10 high-sim pairs (>=0.5) were judged DIFFERENT by user
round2_summary.system_false_negative_rate: 0% — no missed connections in zero-sim pairs
round2_summary.key_finding: MiniLM similarity is triggered by shared vocabulary (agent, skills, CLI) not shared meaning. 0.72-0.74 scores between completely unrelated claims just because both mention 'agents' or 'skills'.

round3_summary.key_finding: System detected 0 similar claims between 'Building Effective Agentic Systems' and 3 other articles user rated as 'shared themes'. Thematic overlap (both about agent patterns/best practices) exists at abstraction level above individual claims.
